name: Order Release
office_task: Turn each job's material list into one purchase order per supplier, and hold any order over the spending limit, or to an unapproved supplier, until a named person releases it.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id and holds its material list (ServiceM8, Simpro, Tradify, Fergus or a job sheet)
the supplier portal or job-system purchasing that issues each order's external id

emits.write: one purchase order per job and supplier, priced from that supplier's catalogue, released by the release rule under the limit to an approved supplier or by a named person otherwise, and sent against the job
emits.readback: the ordering system returns the order's external id, and reading the job's orders back by job_id returns that id with the supplier, the catalogue edition and who or which rule released it; no id back is a failed write, raised to a person, and nothing is sent

emits.write: the supplier's docket matched to its sent order by order id, line by line, with the quantity received and a reason (short, damaged, substituted) on any line that differs
emits.readback: reading the job's record by job_id returns the delivery on that order with one line per ordered line; a docket that names no sent order is never recorded and is raised instead

emits.write: an exception on the order naming the person who owns it: an order waiting for a named release (over the limit, or to a supplier not on the approved list), a code no catalogue holds, an order write with no id back, a docket with no sent order, and every delivery variance (short, over, wrong item, changed price, unaccepted substitution)
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the job_id, the order id, the kind and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
